        "contents": ",\n            )\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn tracing_layer&lt;S&gt;(&amp;self) -&gt; Option&lt;impl Layer&lt;S&gt; + Send + Sync&gt;\n    where\n        S: tracing::Subscriber + for&lt;'span&gt; LookupSpan&lt;'span&gt; + Send + Sync,\n    {\n        self.tracer.as_ref().map(|tracer| {\n            tracing_opentelemetry::layer()\n                .with_tracer(tracer.clone())\n                .with_filter(LevelFilter::TRACE)\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn codex_export_filter(meta: &amp;tracing::Metadata&lt;'_&gt;) -&gt; bool {\n        meta.target().starts_with(\"codex_otel\")\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Drop for OtelProvider {\n    fn drop(&amp;mut self) {\n        if let Some(logger) = &amp;self.logger {\n            let _ = logger.shutdown();\n        }\n        if let Some(tracer_provider) = &amp;self.tracer_provider {\n            let _ = tracer_provider.shutdown();\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub(crate) fn traceparent_context_from_env() -&gt; Option&lt;Context&gt; {\n    TRACEPARENT_CONTEXT\n        .get_or_init(load_traceparent_context)\n        .clone()\n}\n\nfn attach_traceparent_context() {\n    TRACEPARENT_GUARD.with(|guard| {\n        let mut guard = guard.borrow_mut();\n        if guard.is_some() {\n            return;\n        }\n        if let Some(context) = traceparent_context_from_env() {\n            *guard = Some(context.attach());\n        }\n    });\n}\n\nfn load_traceparent_context() -&gt; Option&lt;Context&gt; {\n    let traceparent = env::var(TRACEPARENT_ENV_VAR).ok()?;\n    let tracestate = env::var(TRACESTATE_ENV_VAR).ok();\n\n    match extract_traceparent_context(traceparent, tracestate) {\n        Some(context) =&gt; {\n            debug!(\"TRACEPARENT detected; continuing trace from parent context\");\n            Some(context)\n        }\n        None =&gt; {\n            warn!(\"TRACEPARENT is set but invalid; ignoring trace context\");\n            None\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_traceparent_context",

        "contents": "    pub fn from(settings: &amp;OtelSettings) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;Self&gt;, Box&lt;dyn Error&gt;&gt; {\n        let log_enabled = !matches!(settings.exporter, OtelExporter::None);\n        let trace_enabled = !matches!(settings.trace_exporter, OtelExporter::None);\n\n        if !log_enabled &amp;&amp; !trace_enabled {\n            debug!(\"No exporter enabled in OTLP settings.\");\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n\n        let resource = make_resource(settings);\n        let logger = log_enabled\n            .then(|| build_logger(&amp;resource, &amp;settings.exporter))\n            .transpose()?;\n\n        let tracer_provider = trace_enabled\n            .then(|| build_tracer_provider(&amp;resource, &amp;settings.trace_exporter))\n            .transpose()?;\n\n        let tracer = tracer_provider\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|provider| provider.tracer(settings.service_name.clone()));\n\n        if let Some(provider) = tracer_provider.clone() {\n            let _ = global::set_tracer_provider(provider);\n            global::set_text_map_propagator(TraceContextPropagator::new());\n        }\n        if tracer.is_some() {\n            attach_traceparent_context();\n        }\n\n        Ok(Some(Self {\n            logger,\n            tracer_provider,\n            tracer,\n        }))\n    }\n\n    pub fn logger_layer&lt;S&gt;(&amp;self) -&gt; Option&lt;impl Layer&lt;S&gt; + Send + Sync&gt;\n    where\n        S: tracing::Subscriber + for&lt;'span&gt; LookupSpan&lt;'span&gt; + Send + Sync,\n    {\n        self.logger.as_ref().map(|logger| {\n            OpenTelemetryTracingBridge::new(logger).with_filter(\n                tracing_subscriber::filter::filter_fn(OtelProvider::codex_export_filter),\n            )\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn tracing_layer&lt;S&gt;(&amp;self) -&gt;",

        "contents": "    pub(crate) async fn notify_stream_error(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: &amp;TurnContext,\n        message: impl Into&lt;String&gt;,\n        codex_error: CodexErr,\n    ) {\n        let codex_error_info = CodexErrorInfo::ResponseStreamDisconnected {\n            http_status_code: codex_error.http_status_code_value(),\n        };\n        let event = EventMsg::StreamError(StreamErrorEvent {\n            message: message.into(),\n            codex_error_info: Some(codex_error_info),\n        });\n        self.send_event(turn_context, event).await;\n    }\n\n    async fn maybe_start_ghost_snapshot(\n        self: &amp;Arc&lt;Self&gt;,\n        turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n        cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n    ) {\n        if !self.enabled(Feature::GhostCommit) {\n            return;\n        }\n        let token = match turn_context.tool_call_gate.subscribe().await {\n            Ok(token) =&gt; token,\n            Err(err) =&gt; {\n                warn!(\"failed to subscribe to ghost snapshot readiness: {err}\");\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        info!(\"spawning ghost snapshot task\");\n        let task = GhostSnapshotTask::new(token);\n        Arc::new(task)\n            .run(\n                Arc::new(SessionTaskContext::new(self.clone())),\n                turn_context.clone(),\n                Vec::new(),\n                cancellation_token,\n            )\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the input if there was no task running to inject into\n    pub async fn inject_input(&amp;self, input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;(), Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;&gt; {\n        let mut active = self.active_turn.lock().await;\n        match active.as_mut() {\n            Some(at) =&gt; {\n                let mut ts = at.turn_state.lock().await;\n                ts.push_pending_input(input.into());\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            None =&gt; Err(input),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn get_pending_input(&amp;self) -&gt; Vec&lt;ResponseInputItem&gt;",

        "contents": "pub(crate) async fn run_task(\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    if input.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let auto_compact_limit = turn_context\n        .client\n        .get_model_family()\n        .auto_compact_token_limit()\n        .unwrap_or(i64::MAX);\n    let total_usage_tokens = sess.get_total_token_usage().await;\n    if total_usage_tokens &gt;= auto_compact_limit {\n        run_auto_compact(&amp;sess, &amp;turn_context).await;\n    }\n    let event = EventMsg::TaskStarted(TaskStartedEvent {\n        model_context_window: turn_context.client.get_model_context_window(),\n    });\n    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n\n    let skills_outcome = sess.enabled(Feature::Skills).then(|| {\n        sess.services\n            .skills_manager\n            .skills_for_cwd(&amp;turn_context.cwd)\n    });\n\n    let SkillInjections {\n        items: skill_items,\n        warnings: skill_warnings,\n    } = build_skill_injections(&amp;input, skills_outcome.as_ref()).await;\n\n    for message in skill_warnings {\n        sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::Warning(WarningEvent { message }))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    let initial_input_for_turn: ResponseInputItem = ResponseInputItem::from(input);\n    let response_item: ResponseItem = initial_input_for_turn.clone().into();\n    sess.record_response_item_and_emit_turn_item(turn_context.as_ref(), response_item)\n        .await;\n\n    if !skill_items.is_empty() {\n        sess.record_conversation_items(&amp;turn_context, &amp;skill_items)\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    sess.maybe_start_ghost_snapshot(Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context), cancellation_token.child_token())\n        .await;\n    let mut last_agent_message: Option&lt;String&gt; = None;\n    // Although from the perspective of codex.rs, TurnDiffTracker has the lifecycle of a Task which contains\n    // many turns, from the perspective of the user, it is a single turn.\n    let turn_diff_tracker = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(TurnDiffTracker::new()));\n\n    loop {\n        //",

fn trace_headers() -> HeaderMap {
    let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
    global::get_text_map_propagator(|prop| {
        let context = Span::current().context();
        prop.inject_context(&context, &mut HeaderMapInjector(&mut headers));
    });
    headers
}

```rust
fn trace_headers() -> HeaderMap {
    let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
    global::get_text_map_propagator(|prop| {
        // Span::current().context() returns opentelemetry::Context directly
        let context = Span::current().context();
        prop.inject_context(&context, &mut HeaderMapInjector(&mut headers));
    });
    headers
}
```

```rust
fn trace_headers() -> HeaderMap {
    let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
    global::get_text_map_propagator(|prop| {
        // Span::current().context() returns opentelemetry::Context
        // but there's a version mismatch between opentelemetry 0.30 and tracing-opentelemetry 0.32
        // We need to use the context directly as it should be compatible
        let otel_ctx: OtelContext = Span::current().context();
        prop.inject_context(&otel_ctx, &mut HeaderMapInjector(&mut headers));
    });
    headers
}
```

</details>

</tool-use>

        "contents": "# Codex - Upstream同期と独自機能維持実装ログ\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-19  \n**担当**: zapabob Codex AI Agent  \n**対象リポジトリ**: zapabob/codex (fork of OpenAI/codex)\n\n---\n\n## 📋 概要\n\nOpenAI公式リポジトリ（upstream）と整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持するための大規模マージ作業を実施。\n\n### 🎯 目標\n\n1. upstream/main (OpenAI/codex) の最新変更を取り込む\n2. zapabob独自機能を完全に保持\n3. 競合を適切に解決してビルド可能な状態を維持\n4. 将来的なPR作成の基礎を確立\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 作業前の状況分析\n\n### Gitリモート設定\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\norigin: https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\nupstream: https://github.com/openai/codex.git (既に設定済み)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ブランチ状況\n\n- **current**: &#96;main&#96; ブランチ\n- **zapabob/codex**: 176個の独自コミット\n- **OpenAI/codex**: 50個の新規コミット（未取得）\n\n### 独自機能の確認\n\n✅ **保持すべき主要機能**:\n\n1. **サブエージェントシステム** (&#96;.codex/agents/&#96;)\n   - code-reviewer.yaml\n   - codex-mcp-researcher.yaml\n   - python-reviewer.yaml\n   - researcher.yaml\n   - sec-audit.yaml\n   - test-gen.yaml\n   - ts-reviewer.yaml\n   - unity-reviewer.yaml\n\n2. **自動オーケストレーション機能**\n   - TaskAnalyzer (タスク複雑度自動判定)\n   - AutoOrchestrator (サブエージェント自律並列実行)\n   - ThreeWayMerge実装\n\n3. **Deep Research拡張**\n   - 多段探索エンジン\n   - 引用必須レポート\n   - 矛盾検出機能\n\n4. **独自スクリプト群** (&#96;zapabob/scripts/&#96;)\n   - ビルドモニタリング (tqdm風進捗表示)\n   - 音声通知システム\n   - 実機テストツール\n\n5. **TypeScript SDK拡張** (&#96;zapabob/sdk/typescript/&#96;)\n   - Orchestrator拡張\n   - ストリーミング最適化\n\n6. **詳細ドキュメント** (&#96;zapabob/docs/&#96;)\n   - 日英バイリンガル documentation",
        "signatures": {},

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-12_実装計画書更新_zapabob統合.md",

        "contents": "# Codex 実装計画書更新 - zapabob/codex 要件統合\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-12 19:00 (JST)  \n**実装者**: AI Agent (なんJ風)  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 更新完了\n\n---\n\n## 📋 更新サマリー\n\n既存の Codex 実装計画書（&#96;docs/cursor-implementation-plan.md&#96;）に **zapabob/codex フォーク開発戦略の要件定義書** を統合したで！🔥\n\n### 統合ドキュメント\n\n- **参照元**: &#96;zapabob_codex_requirements_spec.md&#96;（v0.47.0-alpha.1）\n- **更新先**: &#96;docs/cursor-implementation-plan.md&#96;\n- **追加セクション数**: 7 セクション\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 主要更新内容\n\n### 1. フォーク戦略の明確化（セクション 1.0）\n\n#### 上流互換性の維持\n- フォークは**既定で本家と同等挙動**（互換モード）を維持\n- 追加機能は**プラグイン的に有効化**（設定/フラグ）\n- 差分はモジュール分離・DI（依存性注入）で**局所化**\n\n#### 差別化機能（Core Features）\n1. **Deep Research**: APIキー不要の検索フォールバック + 計画的調査\n2. **サブエージェント機構**: タスク分割／並列実行／役割別エージェント\n3. **Gemini CLI統合**: Google Search Grounding 利用\n4. **URLデコーダー**: DuckDuckGo リダイレクト対応\n5. **MCP連携**: IDE統合（Cursor/Windsurf 等）\n\n#### ターゲットペルソナ\n- **個人開発者**: ローカルCLI/IDE補助、検索付き調査、軽量導入・無料運用志向\n- **企業チーム**: CI連携、コードレビュー/テスト生成、自社ポリシー準拠、監査ログ\n- **研究者/LLM開発者**: マルチエージェント実験、プロンプト/推論戦略の検証\n\n### 2. 非機能要件の拡充（セクション 1.2）\n\n追加項目：\n- **再現性**: 重要経路はシード/温度管理、決定性の高い後処理\n- **可観測性**: メトリクス（レイテンシ/エラー/トークン/外部呼数）、p95/p99、キャッシュヒット率\n- **I/O重畳**: 2×以上の実効改善を維持",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "text": "## 🎯 主要更新内容",

          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. フォーク戦略の明確化（セクション 1.0）",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 上流互換性の維持",

            "lineNumber": 28
          },

            "lineNumber": 29

            "text": "#### 差別化機能（Core Features）",

            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **URLデコーダー**: DuckDuckGo リダイレクト対応",

          },

          },

          },

        "contents": "# Codex - Upstream同期と独自機能維持実装ログ\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-19  \n**担当**: zapabob Codex AI Agent  \n**対象リポジトリ**: zapabob/codex (fork of OpenAI/codex)\n\n---\n\n## 📋 概要\n\nOpenAI公式リポジトリ（upstream）と整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持するための大規模マージ作業を実施。\n\n### 🎯 目標\n\n1. upstream/main (OpenAI/codex) の最新変更を取り込む\n2. zapabob独自機能を完全に保持\n3. 競合を適切に解決してビルド可能な状態を維持\n4. 将来的なPR作成の基礎を確立\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 作業前の状況分析\n\n### Gitリモート設定\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\norigin: https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\nupstream: https://github.com/openai/codex.git (既に設定済み)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ブランチ状況\n\n- **current**: &#96;main&#96; ブランチ\n- **zapabob/codex**: 176個の独自コミット\n- **OpenAI/codex**: 50個の新規コミット（未取得）\n\n### 独自機能の確認\n\n✅ **保持すべき主要機能**:\n\n1. **サブエージェントシステム** (&#96;.codex/agents/&#96;)\n   - code-reviewer.yaml\n   - codex-mcp-researcher.yaml\n   - python-reviewer.yaml\n   - researcher.yaml\n   - sec-audit.yaml\n   - test-gen.yaml\n   - ts-reviewer.yaml\n   - unity-reviewer.yaml\n\n2. **自動オーケストレーション機能**\n   - TaskAnalyzer (タスク複雑度自動判定)\n   - AutoOrchestrator (サブエージェント自律並列実行)\n   - ThreeWayMerge実装\n\n3. **Deep Research拡張**\n   - 多段探索エンジン\n   - 引用必須レポート\n   - 矛盾検出機能\n\n4. **独自スクリプト群** (&#96;zapabob/scripts/&#96;)\n   - ビルドモニタリング (tqdm風進捗表示)\n   - 音声通知システム\n   - 実機テストツール\n\n5. **TypeScript SDK拡張** (&#96;zapabob/sdk/typescript/&#96;)\n   - Orchestrator拡張\n   - ストリーミング最適化\n\n6. **詳細ドキュメント** (&#96;zapabob/docs/&#96;)\n   - 日英バイリンガル documentation",

        "contents": "# 公式リポジトリマージ完了 - 独自機能優先戦略\n\n**日付**: 2025-11-06  \n**実装者**: zapabob  \n**状態**: ✅ 完了\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装概要\n\nopenai/codex公式リポジトリ（upstream/main）の最新版をマージ。**zapabob独自機能を優先**する戦略でコンフリクトを解決し、1830+コミットを統合完了。\n\n---\n\n## 📊 マージ前の状態\n\n### リポジトリ状況\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n公式リポジトリ (upstream/main)\n├── 最新コミット: 9a10e80ab\n├── コミット数: 数千+\n└── 状態: zapabobより1830コミット先行\n\nzapabobリポジトリ (origin/main)\n├── 最新コミット: 60bc7e27f\n├── コミット数: 4\n└── 独自機能: サブエージェント、Deep Research、GUI、Windowsドライバー\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 関係性\n- ⚠️ **\"unrelated histories\"** - クリーンな履歴再構築により共通祖先なし\n- 📊 公式より **1830コミット遅れ**\n- 🚀 zapabob独自コミット: **4個**\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 マージ実施内容\n\n### 1. バックアップ作成\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit branch backup-before-merge-20251106-022850\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**: 現在の状態を安全に保存\n\n---\n\n### 2. マージ実行（独自機能優先）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit merge upstream/main \\\n  --allow-unrelated-histories \\\n  -X ours \\\n  -m \"Merge upstream/main with zapabob extensions priority\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**戦略**:\n- &#96;--allow-unrelated-histories&#96;: 関連のない履歴を許可\n- &#96;-X ours&#96;: コンフリクト時にzapabob版を優先\n\n---\n\n### 3. コンフリクト解決\n\n**発生したコンフリクト**: 12ファイル\n\n| ファイル | 解決方法 |\n|---------|---------|\n| &#96;codex-cli/bin/rg&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;codex-cli/scripts/*.sh&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;codex-cli/scripts/*.py&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/mcp-types/*.py&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/protocol-ts/generate-ts&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/responses-api-proxy/npm/bin/*.js&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/scripts/create_github_release&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |\n| &#96;scripts/asciicheck.py&#96; | zapabob版を保持 |",

        "contents": "# Codex 実装計画書更新 - zapabob/codex 要件統合\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-12 19:00 (JST)  \n**実装者**: AI Agent (なんJ風)  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 更新完了\n\n---\n\n## 📋 更新サマリー\n\n既存の Codex 実装計画書（&#96;docs/cursor-implementation-plan.md&#96;）に **zapabob/codex フォーク開発戦略の要件定義書** を統合したで！🔥\n\n### 統合ドキュメント\n\n- **参照元**: &#96;zapabob_codex_requirements_spec.md&#96;（v0.47.0-alpha.1）\n- **更新先**: &#96;docs/cursor-implementation-plan.md&#96;\n- **追加セクション数**: 7 セクション\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 主要更新内容\n\n### 1. フォーク戦略の明確化（セクション 1.0）\n\n#### 上流互換性の維持\n- フォークは**既定で本家と同等挙動**（互換モード）を維持\n- 追加機能は**プラグイン的に有効化**（設定/フラグ）\n- 差分はモジュール分離・DI（依存性注入）で**局所化**\n\n#### 差別化機能（Core Features）\n1. **Deep Research**: APIキー不要の検索フォールバック + 計画的調査\n2. **サブエージェント機構**: タスク分割／並列実行／役割別エージェント\n3. **Gemini CLI統合**: Google Search Grounding 利用\n4. **URLデコーダー**: DuckDuckGo リダイレクト対応\n5. **MCP連携**: IDE統合（Cursor/Windsurf 等）\n\n#### ターゲットペルソナ\n- **個人開発者**: ローカルCLI/IDE補助、検索付き調査、軽量導入・無料運用志向\n- **企業チーム**: CI連携、コードレビュー/テスト生成、自社ポリシー準拠、監査ログ\n- **研究者/LLM開発者**: マルチエージェント実験、プロンプト/推論戦略の検証\n\n### 2. 非機能要件の拡充（セクション 1.2）\n\n追加項目：\n- **再現性**: 重要経路はシード/温度管理、決定性の高い後処理\n- **可観測性**: メトリクス（レイテンシ/エラー/トークン/外部呼数）、p95/p99、キャッシュヒット率\n- **I/O重畳**: 2×以上の実効改善を維持",

        "contents": "# Pull Request: Meta-Orchestration &amp; Parallel Agent Execution\n\n## 🌟 Title / タイトル\n\n**EN**: &#96;feat: Add meta-orchestration with parallel agent execution and dynamic agent creation (zapabob/codex exclusive)&#96;\n\n**JA**: &#96;機能追加: 並列エージェント実行と動的エージェント生成によるメタオーケストレーション（zapabob/codex 独自機能）&#96;\n\n---\n\n## ⚡ What Makes This Fork Unique / 本フォークの独自性\n\n### English\n\nThis PR introduces **features exclusive to zapabob/codex** that extend beyond OpenAI's recent Codex updates (IDE integration, GitHub @codex mentions, async tasks).\n\n**OpenAI's Recent Updates (January 2025)**:\n- ✅ IDE extensions (VS Code, Cursor)\n- ✅ GitHub integration (@codex PR reviews)\n- ✅ Async task execution\n- ✅ Web &amp; Terminal integration\n\n**zapabob/codex EXCLUSIVE Features (This PR)**:\n\n| Feature | openai/codex (Latest) | zapabob/codex | Technical Advantage |\n|---------|----------------------|---------------|---------------------|\n| **Parallel Agent Execution** | ❌ Single-threaded async | ✅ &#96;tokio::spawn&#96; multi-threaded | **2.5x faster** (true parallelism) |\n| **Dynamic Agent Creation** | ❌ Static YAML only | ✅ LLM-generated at runtime | **Infinite flexibility** |\n| **Meta-Orchestration** | ❌ No self-referential | ✅ MCP-based recursion | **Infinite extensibility** |\n| **Token Budget Manager** | ❌ No budget tracking | ✅ &#96;TokenBudgeter&#96; per-agent | **Cost control &amp; fairness** |\n| **Audit Logging** | ❌ Basic logs | ✅ &#96;AgentExecutionEvent&#96; structured | **Full traceability** |\n| **MCP Deep Integration** | ❌ Limited MCP support | ✅ Self-as-tool via MCP | **Recursive AI system** |\n\n**Key Differentiation**:\n- OpenAI's async = single-threaded event loop (Node.js style)\n- zapabob's parallel = true multi-threading via Rust &#96;tokio::spawn&#96;\n- OpenAI's GitHub integration = external PR reviews\n- zapabob's meta-orchestration = Codex spawning Codex instances recursively\n\n**Core Innovation**: A **Self-Orchestrating AI System** where Codex can spawn, manage, and coordinate multiple instances of itself, creating a recursive multi-agent architecture impossible in the official repository's single-process model.\n\n### 日本語\n\n本PRは **zapabob/codex 独自の機能** を追加します。OpenAI の最新アップデート（IDE統合、GitHub @codex、非同期タスク）を超える機能です。",

Terminal integration\n\n**zapabob/codex EXCLUSIVE Features (This PR)**:\n\n| Feature | openai/codex (Latest) | zapabob/codex | Technical Advantage |\n|---------|----------------------|---------------|---------------------|\n| **Parallel Agent Execution** | ❌ Single-threaded async | ✅ &#96;tokio::spawn&#96;         "contents": "# 2025-10-23 Phase 1: 公式リポジトリ統合完了\n\n## Summary\nOpenAI/codex upstream/mainとの統合に成功。独自機能（AgentRuntime, オーケストレーション, DeepResearch）を保持しながらマージ完了。\n\n## Phase 1.1: 上流変更の取り込み\n\n### マージ作業\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\n# 最新コミット: 0b452714 (feat: use actual tokenizer for unified_exec truncation)\ngit merge upstream/main\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 競合解決\n2つのファイルで競合が発生:\n\n#### 1. &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96;\n**競合内容:**\n- HEAD: &#96;dashmap = { workspace = true }&#96; (独自機能用)\n- upstream/main: &#96;codex-utils-tokenizer = { workspace = true }&#96; (公式機能)\n\n**解決方法:** 両方を保持\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\ncodex-utils-tokenizer = { workspace = true }\ndashmap = { workspace = true }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/mod.rs&#96;\n**競合内容:**\n- HEAD: 多数の独自インポート（orchestrator, agents関連）\n- upstream/main: 基本インポートのみ\n\n**解決方法:** すべての独自インポートを保持\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse crate::function_tool::FunctionCallError;\nuse crate::tools::context::SharedTurnDiffTracker;\nuse crate::tools::events::{ToolEmitter, ToolEventCtx, ToolEventFailure, ToolEventStage};\nuse crate::tools::orchestrator::ToolOrchestrator;\nuse crate::tools::runtimes::apply_patch::{ApplyPatchRequest, ApplyPatchRuntime};\nuse crate::tools::runtimes::shell::{ShellRequest, ShellRuntime};\nuse crate::tools::sandboxing::{ToolCtx, ToolError};\nuse codex_utils_string::{take_bytes_at_char_boundary, take_last_bytes_at_char_boundary};\nuse codex_apply_patch::MaybeApplyPatchVerified;\nuse codex_apply_patch::maybe_parse_apply_patch_verified;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::AskForApproval;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### マージコミット\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit add codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml codex-rs/core/src/tools/mod.rs\ngit commit -m \"merge: integrate upstream/main with custom features\"\n# コミットハッシュ: eb8274ee\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Phase 1.2: ビルドとテスト\n\n### ビルド実行\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd codex-rs\n$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR = \"C:\\temp\\codex-target\"",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "---\n\n## 🚀 zapabob/codex Extended Features / zapabob/codex拡張機能\n\nThis section highlights the unique features and enhancements added by [@zapabob](https://github.com/zapabob) to the original [OpenAI/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex) project.\n\nこのセクションでは、[@zapabob](https://github.com/zapabob)が元の[OpenAI/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)プロジェクトに追加した独自機能と拡張を紹介します。\n\n### 🤖 Sub-Agent System / サブエージェントシステム\n\n**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)\n\n**English**: A powerful multi-agent orchestration system that enables parallel execution of specialized AI agents. Supports 8+ predefined agents (code-reviewer, test-gen, sec-audit, deep-researcher) and custom YAML-defined agents. Achieves 2.6x speedup through parallel execution.\n\n**日本語**: 専門AIエージェントの並列実行を可能にする強力なマルチエージェントオーケストレーションシステム。8種類以上の定義済みエージェント（code-reviewer、test-gen、sec-audit、deep-researcher）とカスタムYAML定義エージェントをサポート。並列実行により2.6倍の高速化を実現。\n\n**Implementation / 実装**:\n- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, AgentLoader, PermissionChecker\n- **Agent Definitions / エージェント定義**: &#96;.codex/agents/*.yaml&#96; - YAML-driven configuration\n- **Parallel Execution / 並列実行**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/async_subagent_integration.rs&#96; - AsyncSubAgentIntegration\n- **Token Budget / トークン予算**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/token_budget.rs&#96; - Per-agent limits\n\n**Features / 機能**:\n- Parallel execution / 並列実行: 2.6x faster / 2.6倍高速化\n- Custom agent creation / カスタムエージェント作成: YAML-driven / YAML駆動\n- Conflict resolution / コンフリクト解決: 3 merge strategies / 3種類のマージ戦略\n- Collaboration store / コラボレーションストア: Agent communication / エージェント間通信\n\n**Usage / 使用方法**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Single agent / 単一エージェント",

  "plan": "# 3ブランチマージと独自機能保持プラン\n\n## 現状分析\n\n### ブランチ状況\n- **現在のブランチ**: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;\n  - &#96;upstream/main&#96;は既にマージ済み\n  - 最新コミット: &#96;86e0ef039&#96;\n- **origin/main**: 最新コミット &#96;8a93a25e3&#96; (GUI-CLI bridge統合など)\n- **main**: 最新コミット &#96;595426bf9&#96; (origin/mainより古い)\n- **共通祖先**: &#96;595426bf9&#96; (merge-upstream-2025-12-20とorigin/main/mainの共通点)\n\n### 保持すべき独自機能（zapabob/codex）\n1. **Deep Research機能** (&#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96;)\n2. **サブエージェントシステム** (&#96;.codex/agents/&#96;)\n   - code-reviewer.yaml, researcher.yaml, sec-audit.yaml など8個\n3. **Orchestration機能拡張** (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96;)\n   - auto_orchestrator, collaboration_store, parallel_execution, plan_orchestrator\n4. **agentsモジュール** (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96;)\n   - runtime, competition, types, loader, budgeter\n5. **plan機能** (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96;) - 公式では削除済みだが独自実装として維持\n6. **Gemini CLI MCP Server** (&#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;)\n7. **MCPサーバーツール拡張** (7ツール)\n8. **日本語音声通知機能**\n9. **zapabobスクリプト群** (&#96;zapabob/scripts/&#96;)\n\n### 保持すべき公式機能\n- skills機能（公式の最新実装）\n- バグフィクス（upstream/mainから）\n- 不具合修正（origin/mainから）\n\n## 実装手順\n\n### Phase 1: 現状確認とバックアップ\n\n1. **作業前のバックアップ作成**\n   - &#96;git branch backup-before-3way-merge-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)&#96;\n   - 現在の作業ツリーの状態を保存\n\n2. **各ブランチの差分確認**\n   - &#96;git diff merge-upstream-2025-12-20..origin/main&#96; - origin/mainの追加変更を確認\n   - &#96;git diff merge-upstream-2025-12-20..main&#96; - mainの追加変更を確認\n   - コンフリクト予測ファイルをリストアップ\n\n3. **独自機能ファイルの保護リスト作成**\n   - Deep Research関連ファイル\n   - Orchestration関連ファイル\n   - agents関連ファイル\n   - plan機能関連ファイル\n\n### Phase 2: 3ブランチマージ実行\n\n1. **origin/mainをマージ**\n   - &#96;git merge origin/main --no-commit&#96;\n   - コンフリクト発生時は独自機能を優先（&#96;-X ours&#96;を検討）\n   - GUI-CLI bridge統合などの新機能を保持\n\n2. **mainをマージ**\n   - &#96;git merge main --no-commit&#96;\n   - 既にorigin/mainに含まれている場合はスキップ\n   - 追加の変更があれば統合\n\n3. **コンフリクト解決戦略**\n   - **公式のコア機能変更**: 公式を優先\n   - **zapabob独自機能**: 完全保持\n   - **両方に存在する機能**: 統合を試みる（例: skills機能）\n   - **設定ファイル**: zapabob版を優先（独自設定保持）\n\n### Phase 3: コンフリクト解消\n\n1. **コンフリクトファイルの分類**\n   - コア機能（公式優先）: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/core/src/client.rs&#96; など\n   - 独自機能（完全保持）: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; など\n   - 設定ファイル（zapabob優先）: &#96;config.toml&#96;, &#96;.gitignore&#96; など\n   - 共通機能（統合）: skills機能、MCP関連\n\n2. **コンフリクト解決**\n   - 各ファイルごとに適切な戦略を適用\n   - 解決後、&#96;git add&#96;でステージング\n\n3. **ビルドエラー確認**\n   - &#96;cargo check --all-features&#96; で即座にエラー確認\n   - エラーがあれば修正\n\n### Phase 4: 高速差分ビルドとインストール\n\n1. **ビルド環境最適化**\n   - &#96;CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/fast&#96; で高速ビルドディレクトリ設定\n   - &#96;RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache&#96; でキャッシュ有効化（利用可能な場合）\n\n2. **差分ビルド実行**\n   - &#96;cargo build -p codex-cli -p codex-tui --release&#96;\n   - 変更されたクレートのみ再ビルド\n   - 進捗をtqdm風に視覚化（Pythonスクリプト使用）\n\n3. **バイナリ上書きインストール**\n   - &#96;cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --force&#96;\n   - &#96;cargo install --path codex-rs/tui --force&#96;\n   - 既存のバイナリを上書き\n\n### Phase 5: 実機テスト\n\n1. **基本動作確認**\n   - &#96;codex --version&#96; - バージョン確認\n   - &#96;codex --help&#96; - ヘルプ表示確認\n\n2. **機能テスト**\n   - skills機能の動作確認\n   - Deep Research機能の動作確認\n   - Orchestration機能の動作確認\n   - MCPサーバー接続確認\n\n3. **統合テスト**\n   - TUI起動確認\n   - CLIコマンド実行確認\n   - エージェント呼び出し確認\n\n4. **エラー確認**\n   - ログファイルの確認\n   - パニックやエラーの有無を確認\n\n## 主要ファイル\n\n### マージ対象（注意が必要）\n- &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96; - 依存関係の統合\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs&#96; - モジュール公開の統合\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96; - コア機能の統合\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/client.rs&#96; - クライアント実装の統合\n- &#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/&#96; - MCPサーバー実装の統合\n\n### 保護対象（完全保持）\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96; - 全体\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96; - zapabob拡張部分\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - 全体\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96; - 全体\n- &#96;.codex/agents/&#96; - 全体\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/&#96; - 全体\n\n### 統合対象（両方の機能を保持）\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/skills/&#96; - skills機能の統合\n- &#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/src/&#96; - MCPツール拡張の統合\n\n## 注意事項\n\n- **公式の変更を優先**（コア機能、バグフィクス、セキュリティパッチ）\n- **zapabob独自機能は完全保持**（削除・上書きしない）\n- **コンフリクト解決時は慎重に**（両方の機能を統合できるか検討）\n- **ビルドエラーは即座に修正**（次のフェーズに進む前に）\n- **テストは段階的に**（基本→機能→統合の順で）\n\n## リスクと対策\n\n### リスク1: 大量のコンフリクト\n- **対策**: ファイルごとに分類し、戦略を明確化\n\n### リスク2: ビルドエラー\n- **対策**: 段階的にビルドし、エラーを即座に修正\n\n### リスク3: 機能の破壊\n- **対策**: 各フェーズでテストを実施し、問題を早期発見\n\n### リスク4: パフォーマンス低下\n- **対策**: 高速差分ビルドを活用し、不要な再ビルドを回避",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFixed Continuous Integration Test for Codex\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport os\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\ntry:\n    from tqdm import tqdm\nexcept ImportError:\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\", \"tqdm\"], check=True)\n    from tqdm import tqdm\n\nclass ContinuousIntegrationTester:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.start_time = datetime.now()\n        self.results = {}\n        self.project_root = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\n        \n    def run_command(self, cmd, cwd=None, timeout=30):\n        result = {\n            \"command\": \" \".join(cmd) if isinstance(cmd, list) else cmd,\n            \"success\": False,\n            \"stdout\": \"\",\n            \"stderr\": \"\",\n            \"execution_time\": 0\n        }\n        \n        start_time = time.time()\n        try:\n            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)\n            result[\"success\"] = proc.returncode == 0\n            result[\"stdout\"] = proc.stdout\n            result[\"stderr\"] = proc.stderr\n        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n            result[\"stderr\"] = f\"Timeout after {timeout}s\"\n        except Exception as e:\n            result[\"stderr\"] = str(e)\n            \n        result[\"execution_time\"] = time.time() - start_time\n        return result\n    \n    def test_core_systems(self):\n        \"\"\"Test core system components\"\"\"\n        print(\"[CORE] Testing core system components...\")\n        \n        tests = [\n            ([\"codex\", \"--version\"], \"CLI Version\"),\n        ]\n        \n        results = {}\n        for cmd, desc in tqdm(tests, desc=\"Core Tests\"):\n            result = self.run_command(cmd)\n            results[desc] = result\n            status = \"[OK]\" if result[\"success\"] else \"[FAIL]\"\n            tqdm.write(f\"{status} {desc}\")\n            \n        return results\n    \n    def test_build_systems(self):\n        \"\"\"Test build systems\"\"\"",

        "contents": "pub fn sse(events: Vec&lt;Value&gt;) -&gt; String {\n    use std::fmt::Write as _;\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    for ev in events {\n        let kind = ev.get(\"type\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap();\n        writeln!(&amp;mut out, \"event: {kind}\").unwrap();\n        if !ev.as_object().map(|o| o.len() == 1).unwrap_or(false) {\n            write!(&amp;mut out, \"data: {ev}\\n\\n\").unwrap();\n        } else {\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// Convenience: SSE event for a completed response with a specific id.\npub fn ev_completed(id: &amp;str) -&gt; Value {\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"response.completed\",\n        \"response\": {\n            \"id\": id,\n            \"usage\": {\"input_tokens\":0,\"input_tokens_details\":null,\"output_tokens\":0,\"output_tokens_details\":null,\"total_tokens\":0}\n        }\n    })\n}\n\n/// Convenience: SSE event for a created response with a specific id.\npub fn ev_response_created(id: &amp;str) -&gt; Value {\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"response.created\",\n        \"response\": {\n            \"id\": id,\n        }\n    })\n}\n\npub fn ev_completed_with_tokens(id: &amp;str, total_tokens: i64) -&gt; Value {\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"response.output_item.done\",\n        \"item\": {\n            \"type\": \"message\",\n            \"role\": \"assistant\",\n            \"id\": id,\n            \"content\": [{\"type\": \"output_text\", \"text\": text}]\n        }\n    })\n}\n\npub fn ev_message_item_added(id: &amp;str, text: &amp;str) -&gt; This mirrors the payload produced by the Responses API when the model\n/// invokes &#96;apply_patch&#96; directly (before we convert it to a function call).\npub fn ev_apply_patch_custom_tool_call(call_id: &amp;str, patch: &amp;str) -&gt; Value {\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"response.output_item.done\",\n        \"item\": {\n            \"type\": \"custom_tool_call\",\n            \"name\": \"apply_patch\",\n            \"input\": patch,\n            \"call_id\": call_id\n        }\n    })\n}\n\n/// Convenience: SSE event for an &#96;apply_patch&#96; function call.         "contents": "fn get_command(args: &amp;ExecCommandArgs, session_shell: Arc&lt;Shell&gt;) -&gt; Vec&lt;String&gt; {\n    let model_shell = args.shell.as_ref().map(|shell_str| {\n        let mut shell = get_shell_by_model_provided_path(&amp;PathBuf::from(shell_str));\n        shell.shell_snapshot = None;\n        shell\n    });\n\n    let shell = model_shell.as_ref().unwrap_or(session_shell.as_ref());\n\n    shell.derive_exec_args(&amp;args.cmd, args.login)\n}\n\nfn format_response(response: &amp;UnifiedExecResponse) -&gt; String {\n    let mut sections = Vec::new();\n\n    if !response.chunk_id.is_empty() {\n        sections.push(format!(\"Chunk ID: {}\", response.chunk_id));\n    }\n\n    let wall_time_seconds = response.wall_time.as_secs_f64();\n    sections.push(format!(\"Wall time: {wall_time_seconds:.4} seconds\"));\n\n    if let Some(exit_code) = response.exit_code {\n        sections.push(format!(\"Process exited with code {exit_code}\"));\n    }\n\n    if let Some(process_id) = &amp;response.process_id {\n        // Training still uses \"session ID\".\n        sections.push(format!(\"Process running with session ID {process_id}\"));\n    }\n\n    if let Some(original_token_count) = response.original_token_count {\n        sections.push(format!(\"Original token count: {original_token_count}\"));\n    }\n\n    sections.push(\"Output:\".to_string());\n    sections.push(response.output.clone());\n\n    sections.join(\"\\n\")\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;",

Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let cwd = request\n            .workdir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| context.turn.cwd.clone());\n\n        let session = self\n            .open_session_with_sandbox(\n                &amp;request.command,\n                cwd.clone(),\n                request.sandbox_permissions,\n                request.justification,\n                context,\n            )\n            .await;\n\n        let session = match session {\n            Ok(session) =&gt; Arc::new(session),\n            Err(err) =&gt; {\n                self.release_process_id(&amp;request.process_id).await;\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        };\n\n        let transcript = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(CommandTranscript::default()));\n        start_streaming_output(&amp;session, context, Arc::clone(&amp;transcript));\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        // For the initial exec_command call, we both stream output to events\n        // (via start_streaming_output above) and collect a snapshot here for\n        // the tool response body.\n        let OutputHandles {\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = session.output_handles();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let exit_code = session.exit_code();",

        "contents": "    async fn turn_start(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: TurnStartParams) {\n        let (_, conversation) = match self.conversation_from_thread_id(&amp;params.thread_id).await {\n            Ok(v) =&gt; v,\n            Err(error) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Map v2 input items to core input items.\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = params\n            .input\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(V2UserInput::into_core)\n            .collect();\n\n        let has_any_overrides = params.cwd.is_some()\n            || params.approval_policy.is_some()\n            || params.sandbox_policy.is_some()\n            || params.model.is_some()\n            || params.effort.is_some()\n            || params.summary.is_some();\n\n        // If any overrides are provided, update the session turn context first.\n        if has_any_overrides {\n            let _ = conversation\n                .submit(Op::OverrideTurnContext {\n                    cwd: params.cwd,\n                    approval_policy: params.approval_policy.map(AskForApproval::to_core),\n                    sandbox_policy: params.sandbox_policy.map(|p| p.to_core()),\n                    model: params.model,\n                    effort: params.effort.map(Some),\n                    summary: params.summary,\n                })\n                .await;\n        }\n\n        // Start the turn by submitting the user input.         "contents": "            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn fuzzy_file_search(&amp;mut self, request_id: RequestId, params: FuzzyFileSearchParams) {\n        let FuzzyFileSearchParams {\n            query,\n            roots,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = params;\n\n        let cancel_flag = match cancellation_token.clone() {\n            Some(token) =&gt; {\n                let mut pending_fuzzy_searches = self.pending_fuzzy_searches.lock().await;\n                // if a cancellation_token is provided and a pending_request exists for\n                // that token, cancel it\n                if let Some(existing) = pending_fuzzy_searches.get(&amp;token) {\n                    existing.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n                }\n                let flag = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n                pending_fuzzy_searches.insert(token.clone(), flag.clone());\n                flag\n            }\n            None =&gt; Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),\n        };\n\n        let results = match query.as_str() {\n            \"\" =&gt; vec![],\n            _ =&gt; run_fuzzy_file_search(query, roots, cancel_flag.clone()).await,\n        };\n\n        if let Some(token) = cancellation_token {\n            let mut pending_fuzzy_searches = self.pending_fuzzy_searches.lock().await;\n            if let Some(current_flag) = pending_fuzzy_searches.get(&amp;token)\n                &amp;&amp; Arc::ptr_eq(current_flag, &amp;cancel_flag)\n            {\n                pending_fuzzy_searches.remove(&amp;token);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let response = FuzzyFileSearchResponse { files: results };\n        self.outgoing.send_response(request_id, response).await;\n    }\n\n    async fn upload_feedback(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId,",

        "contents": "    async fn emit_review_started(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        turn: Turn,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n        review_thread_id: String,\n    ) {\n        let response = ReviewStartResponse {\n            turn: turn.clone(),\n            review_thread_id,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id.clone(), response)\n            .await;\n\n        let notif = TurnStartedNotification {\n            thread_id: parent_thread_id,\n            turn,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_server_notification(ServerNotification::TurnStarted(notif))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn start_inline_review(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        parent_conversation: Arc&lt;CodexConversation&gt;,\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n        display_text: &amp;str,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n    ) -&gt; std::result::Result&lt;(), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        let turn_id = parent_conversation\n            .submit(Op::Review { review_request })\n            .await;\n\n        match turn_id {\n            Ok(turn_id) =&gt; {\n                let turn = Self::build_review_turn(turn_id, display_text);\n                self.emit_review_started(\n                    request_id,\n                    turn,\n                    parent_thread_id.clone(),\n                    parent_thread_id,\n                )\n                .await;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(err) =&gt; Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to start review: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn start_detached_review(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId",

        "contents": "    async fn skills_list(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: SkillsListParams) {\n        let SkillsListParams { cwds, force_reload } = params;\n        let cwds = if cwds.is_empty() {\n            vec![self.config.cwd.clone()]\n        } else {\n            cwds\n        };\n\n        let skills_manager = self.conversation_manager.skills_manager();\n        let data = cwds\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|cwd| {\n                let outcome = skills_manager.skills_for_cwd_with_options(&amp;cwd, force_reload);\n                let errors = errors_to_info(&amp;outcome.errors);\n                let skills = skills_to_info(&amp;outcome.skills);\n                codex_app_server_protocol::SkillsListEntry {\n                    cwd,\n                    skills,\n                    errors,\n                }\n            })\n            .collect();\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id, SkillsListResponse { data })\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn interrupt_conversation(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        request_id: RequestId",

        "contents": "    async fn emit_review_started(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        turn: Turn,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n        review_thread_id: String,\n    ) {\n        let response = ReviewStartResponse {\n            turn: turn.clone(),\n            review_thread_id,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id.clone(), response)\n            .await;\n\n        let notif = TurnStartedNotification {\n            thread_id: parent_thread_id,\n            turn,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_server_notification(ServerNotification::TurnStarted(notif))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn start_inline_review(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        parent_conversation: Arc&lt;CodexConversation&gt;,\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n        display_text: &amp;str,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n    ) -&gt; std::result::Result&lt;(), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        let turn_id = parent_conversation\n            .submit(Op::Review { review_request })\n            .await;\n\n        match turn_id {\n            Ok(turn_id) =&gt; {\n                let turn = Self::build_review_turn(turn_id, display_text);\n                self.emit_review_started(\n                    request_id,\n                    turn,\n                    parent_thread_id.clone(),\n                    parent_thread_id,\n                )\n                .await;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(err) =&gt; Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to start review: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn start_detached_review(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId",

        "contents": "    async fn send_user_message(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: SendUserMessageParams) {\n        let SendUserMessageParams {\n            conversation_id,\n            items,\n        } = params;\n        let Ok(conversation) = self\n            .conversation_manager\n            .get_conversation(conversation_id)\n            .await\n        else {\n            let error = JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"conversation not found: {conversation_id}\"),\n                data: None,\n            };\n            self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n            return;\n        };\n\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = items\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|item| match item {\n                WireInputItem::Text { text } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Text { text },\n                WireInputItem::Image { image_url } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Image { image_url },\n                WireInputItem::LocalImage { path } =&gt; CoreInputItem::LocalImage { path },\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Submit user input to the conversation.\n        let _ = conversation\n            .submit(Op::UserInput {\n                items: mapped_items,\n            })\n            .await;\n\n        // Acknowledge with an empty result.\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id, SendUserMessageResponse {})\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn send_user_turn",

        "contents": "            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn fuzzy_file_search(&amp;mut self, request_id: RequestId, params: FuzzyFileSearchParams) {\n        let FuzzyFileSearchParams {\n            query,\n            roots,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = params;\n\n        let cancel_flag = match cancellation_token.clone() {\n            Some(token) =&gt; {\n                let mut pending_fuzzy_searches = self.pending_fuzzy_searches.lock().await;\n                // if a cancellation_token is provided and a pending_request exists for\n                // that token, cancel it\n                if let Some(existing) = pending_fuzzy_searches.get(&amp;token) {\n                    existing.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n                }\n                let flag = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n                pending_fuzzy_searches.insert(token.clone(), flag.clone());\n                flag\n            }\n            None =&gt; Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),\n        };\n\n        let results = match query.as_str() {\n            \"\" =&gt; vec![],\n            _ =&gt; run_fuzzy_file_search(query, roots, cancel_flag.clone()).await,\n        };\n\n        if let Some(token) = cancellation_token {\n            let mut pending_fuzzy_searches = self.pending_fuzzy_searches.lock().await;\n            if let Some(current_flag) = pending_fuzzy_searches.get(&amp;token)\n                &amp;&amp; Arc::ptr_eq(current_flag, &amp;cancel_flag)\n            {\n                pending_fuzzy_searches.remove(&amp;token);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let response = FuzzyFileSearchResponse { files: results };\n        self.outgoing.send_response(request_id, response).await;\n    }\n\n    async fn upload_feedback(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId,",

All relative paths provided by\n    /// the model as well as sandbox policies are resolved against this path\n    /// instead of &#96;std::env::current_dir()&#96;.\n    pub(crate) cwd: PathBuf,\n    pub(crate) developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) approval_policy: AskForApproval,\n    pub(crate) sandbox_policy: SandboxPolicy,\n    pub(crate) shell_environment_policy: ShellEnvironmentPolicy,\n    pub(crate) tools_config: ToolsConfig,\n    pub(crate) ghost_snapshot: GhostSnapshotConfig,\n    pub(crate) final_output_json_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    pub(crate) codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub(crate) tool_call_gate: Arc&lt;ReadinessFlag&gt;,\n    pub(crate) exec_policy: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;ExecPolicy&gt;&gt;,\n    pub(crate) truncation_policy: TruncationPolicy,\n}\n\nimpl TurnContext {\n    pub(crate) fn resolve_path(&amp;self, path: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; PathBuf {\n        path.as_ref()\n            .map(PathBuf::from)\n            .map_or_else(|| self.cwd.clone(), |p| self.cwd.join(p))\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn compact_prompt(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;str {\n        self.compact_prompt\n            .as_deref()\n            .unwrap_or(compact::SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT)\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).",

        "contents": "    pub(super) async fn open_session_with_sandbox(\n        &amp;self,\n        command: &amp;[String],\n        cwd: PathBuf,\n        sandbox_permissions: SandboxPermissions,\n        justification: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        context: &amp;UnifiedExecContext,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;UnifiedExecSession, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let env = apply_unified_exec_env(create_env(&amp;context.turn.shell_environment_policy));\n        let features = context.session.features();\n        let mut orchestrator = ToolOrchestrator::new();\n        let mut runtime = UnifiedExecRuntime::new(self);\n        let exec_approval_requirement = create_exec_approval_requirement_for_command(\n            &amp;context.turn.exec_policy,\n            &amp;features,\n            command,\n            context.turn.approval_policy,\n            &amp;context.turn.sandbox_policy,\n            sandbox_permissions,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let req = UnifiedExecToolRequest::new(\n            command.to_vec(),\n            cwd,\n            env,\n            sandbox_permissions,\n            justification,\n            exec_approval_requirement,\n        );\n        let tool_ctx = ToolCtx {\n            session: context.session.as_ref(),\n            turn: context.turn.as_ref(),\n            call_id: context.call_id.clone(),\n            tool_name: \"exec_command\".to_string(),\n        };\n        orchestrator\n            .run(\n                &amp;mut runtime,\n                &amp;req,\n                &amp;tool_ctx,\n                context.turn.as_ref(),\n                context.turn.approval_policy,\n            )\n            .await\n            .map_err(|e| UnifiedExecError::create_session(format!(\"{e:?}\")))\n    }\n\n    pub(super) async fn collect_output_until_deadline",

        "contents": "        store.remove(process_id);\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn exec_command(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: ExecCommandRequest,\n        context: &amp;UnifiedExecContext,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let cwd = request\n            .workdir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| context.turn.cwd.clone());\n\n        let session = self\n            .open_session_with_sandbox(\n                &amp;request.command,\n                cwd.clone(),\n                request.sandbox_permissions,\n                request.justification,\n                context,\n            )\n            .await;\n\n        let session = match session {\n            Ok(session) =&gt; Arc::new(session),\n            Err(err) =&gt; {\n                self.release_process_id(&amp;request.process_id).await;\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        };\n\n        let transcript = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(CommandTranscript::default()));\n        start_streaming_output(&amp;session, context, Arc::clone(&amp;transcript));\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        // For the initial exec_command call, we both stream output to events\n        // (via start_streaming_output above) and collect a snapshot here for\n        // the tool response body.\n        let OutputHandles {\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = session.output_handles();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let exit_code = session.exit_code();",

        "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\nuse codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ReasoningConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            effort: ReasoningEffort::default(),\n            summary: ReasoningSummary::default(),\n            verbosity: Verbosity::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

&amp;'static str {\n        self.info().key\n    }\n\n    pub fn stage(self) -&gt; Stage {\n        self.info().stage\n    }\n\n    pub fn default_enabled(self) -&gt; bool {\n        self.info().default_enabled\n    }\n\n    fn info(self) -&gt;         "contents": " Vec&lt;(String, serde_json::Value)&gt; {\n        let mut tool_calls = Vec::new();\n\n        // パターン: TOOL_CALL: tool_name(arg1=\"value1\", arg2=\"value2\")\n        // 簡易実装: JSONフォーマットも検出\n        for line in response.lines() {\n            let line = line.trim();\n\n            // TOOL_CALL: codex_read_file(path=\"src/auth.rs\")\n            if line.starts_with(\"TOOL_CALL:\")\n                &amp;&amp; let Some(call_str) = line.strip_prefix(\"TOOL_CALL:\").map(str::trim)\n                &amp;&amp; let Some((tool_name, args_str)) = call_str.split_once('(')\n            {\n                let tool_name = tool_name.trim().to_string();\n                let args_str = args_str.trim_end_matches(')').trim();\n\n                // 簡易パース: key=\"value\" 形式\n                let mut args = serde_json::Map::new();\n                for part in args_str.split(',') {\n                    if let Some((key, value)) = part.split_once('=') {\n                        let key = key.trim().to_string();\n                        let value = value.trim().trim_matches('\"').to_string();\n                        args.insert(key, serde_json::Value::String(value));\n                    }\n                }\n\n                tool_calls.push((tool_name, serde_json::Value::Object(args)));\n            }\n        }\n\n        tool_calls\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCPツールを実行\n    async fn execute_codex_mcp_tool(\n        &amp;self,\n        mcp_client: &amp;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;",

        "contents": "impl ToolsConfig {\n    pub fn new(params: &amp;ToolsConfigParams) -&gt; Self {\n        let ToolsConfigParams {\n            model_family,\n            features,\n        } = params;\n        let include_apply_patch_tool = features.enabled(Feature::ApplyPatchFreeform);\n        let include_web_search_request = features.enabled(Feature::WebSearchRequest);\n        let include_view_image_tool = features.enabled(Feature::ViewImageTool);\n\n        let shell_type = if !features.enabled(Feature::ShellTool) {\n            ConfigShellToolType::Disabled\n        } else if features.enabled(Feature::UnifiedExec) {\n            // If ConPTY not supported (for old Windows versions), fallback on ShellCommand.\n            if codex_utils_pty::conpty_supported() {\n                ConfigShellToolType::UnifiedExec\n            } else {\n                ConfigShellToolType::ShellCommand\n            }\n        } else {\n            model_family.shell_type\n        };\n\n        let apply_patch_tool_type = match model_family.apply_patch_tool_type {\n            Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform) =&gt; Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform),\n            Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Function) =&gt; Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Function),\n            None =&gt; {\n                if include_apply_patch_tool {\n                    Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform)\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        Self {\n            shell_type,\n            apply_patch_tool_type,\n            web_search_request: include_web_search_request,\n            include_view_image_tool,\n            experimental_supported_tools: model_family.experimental_supported_tools.clone(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Generic JSON‑Schema subset needed for our tool definitions\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(tag = \"type\", rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub(crate) enum JsonSchema {\n    Boolean",

pub fn create_apply_patch_sse_response(
    patch_content: &str,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // Use shell command to call apply_patch with heredoc format
    let shell_command = format!("apply_patch <<'EOF'\n{patch_content}\nEOF");
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": ["bash", "-lc", shell_command]
    }))?;

    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "shell",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

// Alias for create_shell_sse_response
pub fn create_shell_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    create_shell_sse_response(command, workdir, timeout_ms, call_id)
}

// Create SSE response for exec_command (unified_exec tool)
pub fn create_exec_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // unified_exec tool uses the same format as shell
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": command,
        "workdir": workdir.map(|w| w.to_string_lossy()),
        "timeout": timeout_ms
    }))?;
    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "unified_exec",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

        "contents": " Vec&lt;(String, serde_json::Value)&gt; {\n        let mut tool_calls = Vec::new();\n\n        // パターン: TOOL_CALL: tool_name(arg1=\"value1\", arg2=\"value2\")\n        // 簡易実装: JSONフォーマットも検出\n        for line in response.lines() {\n            let line = line.trim();\n\n            // TOOL_CALL: codex_read_file(path=\"src/auth.rs\")\n            if line.starts_with(\"TOOL_CALL:\")\n                &amp;&amp; let Some(call_str) = line.strip_prefix(\"TOOL_CALL:\").map(str::trim)\n                &amp;&amp; let Some((tool_name, args_str)) = call_str.split_once('(')\n            {\n                let tool_name = tool_name.trim().to_string();\n                let args_str = args_str.trim_end_matches(')').trim();\n\n                // 簡易パース: key=\"value\" 形式\n                let mut args = serde_json::Map::new();\n                for part in args_str.split(',') {\n                    if let Some((key, value)) = part.split_once('=') {\n                        let key = key.trim().to_string();\n                        let value = value.trim().trim_matches('\"').to_string();\n                        args.insert(key, serde_json::Value::String(value));\n                    }\n                }\n\n                tool_calls.push((tool_name, serde_json::Value::Object(args)));\n            }\n        }\n\n        tool_calls\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCPツールを実行\n    async fn execute_codex_mcp_tool(\n        &amp;self,\n        mcp_client: &amp;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;",

        "contents": "        store.remove(process_id);\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn exec_command(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: ExecCommandRequest,\n        context: &amp;UnifiedExecContext,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let cwd = request\n            .workdir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| context.turn.cwd.clone());\n\n        let session = self\n            .open_session_with_sandbox(\n                &amp;request.command,\n                cwd.clone(),\n                request.sandbox_permissions,\n                request.justification,\n                context,\n            )\n            .await;\n\n        let session = match session {\n            Ok(session) =&gt; Arc::new(session),\n            Err(err) =&gt; {\n                self.release_process_id(&amp;request.process_id).await;\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        };\n\n        let transcript = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(CommandTranscript::default()));\n        start_streaming_output(&amp;session, context, Arc::clone(&amp;transcript));\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        // For the initial exec_command call, we both stream output to events\n        // (via start_streaming_output above) and collect a snapshot here for\n        // the tool response body.\n        let OutputHandles {\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = session.output_handles();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let exit_code = session.exit_code();",

        "contents": "            for (tool_name, tool_args) in tool_calls {\n                if !allowed_tools.contains(&amp;tool_name) {\n                    let error_msg =\n                        format!(\"ERROR: Tool '{tool_name}' is not permitted for this agent\");\n                    tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                info!(\n                    \"Executing Codex MCP tool: {} with args: {:?}\",\n                    tool_name, tool_args\n                );\n\n                match self\n                    .execute_codex_mcp_tool(&amp;mcp_client, &amp;tool_name, tool_args)\n                    .await\n                {\n                    Ok(result) =&gt; {\n                        tool_results.push(format!(\"TOOL_RESULT[{tool_name}]: {result}\"));\n                    }\n                    Err(e) =&gt; {\n                        let error_msg = format!(\"ERROR executing tool '{tool_name}': {e}\");\n                        error!(\"{error_msg}\");\n                        tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // ツール結果をLLMにフィードバック\n            let feedback = tool_results.join(\"\\n\\n\");\n            conversation_history.push((\"user\".to_string(), feedback.clone()));\n            artifacts.push(format!(\"--- Tool Execution Results ---\\n{feedback}\"));\n        }\n\n        info!(\"Agent '{}' completed execution\", agent_def.name);\n\n        Ok(artifacts)\n    }\n\n    /// LLMを呼び出してエージェントの応答を取得\n    async fn call_llm_for_agent(&amp;self, conversation: &amp;[(String, String)]) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n        // プロンプト構築（最新のメッセージのみを使用）\n        let last_message = conversation\n            .last()\n            .",

        "contents": "        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let original_token_count = approx_token_count(&amp;text);\n        let chunk_id = generate_chunk_id();\n\n        // After polling, refresh_session_state tells us whether the PTY is\n        // still alive or has exited and been removed from the store; we thread\n        // that through so the handler can tag TerminalInteraction with an\n        // appropriate process_id and exit_code.\n        let status = self.refresh_session_state(process_id.as_str()).await;\n        let (process_id, exit_code, event_call_id) = match status {\n            SessionStatus::Alive {\n                exit_code,\n                call_id,\n                process_id,\n            } =&gt; (Some(process_id), exit_code, call_id),\n            SessionStatus::Exited { exit_code, entry } =&gt; {\n                let call_id = entry.call_id.clone();\n                (None, exit_code, call_id)\n            }\n            SessionStatus::Unknown =&gt; {\n                return Err(UnifiedExecError::UnknownSessionId {\n                    process_id: request.process_id.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        let response = UnifiedExecResponse {\n            event_call_id,\n            chunk_id,\n            wall_time,\n            output,\n            raw_output: collected,\n            process_id,\n            exit_code,\n            original_token_count: Some(original_token_count),\n            session_command: Some(session_command.clone()),\n        };\n\n        if response.process_id.is_some() {\n            Self::emit_waiting_status(&amp;session_ref, &amp;turn_ref, &amp;session_command).await;\n        }\n\n        Ok(response)\n    }\n\n    async fn refresh_session_state",

Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let process_id = request.process_id.to_string();\n\n        let PreparedSessionHandles {\n            writer_tx,\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n            session_ref,\n            turn_ref,\n            command: session_command,\n            process_id,\n            ..\n        } = self.prepare_session_handles(process_id.as_str()).await?;\n\n        if !request.input.is_empty() {\n            Self::send_input(&amp;writer_tx, request.input.as_bytes()).await?;\n            // Give the remote process a brief window to react so that we are\n            // more likely to capture its output in the poll below.\n            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;\n        }\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let original_token_count = approx_token_count(&amp;text);",

        "contents": "        self.collaboration_store\n            .store_agent_result(agent_name.to_string(), result.clone());\n\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    /// エージェントを実際に実行\n    async fn execute_agent(\n        &amp;self,\n        agent_def: &amp;AgentDefinition,\n        goal: &amp;str,\n        inputs: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        _deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n        debug!(\"Executing agent '{}' with goal: {}\", agent_def.name, goal);\n\n        // 1. システムプロンプト構築（シンプル版）\n        let _system_prompt = format!(\"You are a {} agent. {}\", agent_def.name, agent_def.goal);\n\n        // 2. ユーザー入力を構築（タスクとinputsを含む）\n        let inputs_text = if inputs.is_empty() {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            let mut text = String::from(\"\\n\\nProvided inputs:\\n\");\n            for (key, value) in &amp;inputs {\n                text.push_str(&amp;format!(\"- {key}: {value}\\n\"));\n            }\n            text\n        };\n\n        let user_message = format!(\n            \"Task: {goal}{inputs_text}\\n\\nPlease analyze the task and provide a detailed response.\"\n        );\n\n        // 3. ModelClient作成\n        let model = self.config.model.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"gpt-5.2-codex\");\n        let model_family = crate::models_manager::model_family::find_family_for_model(model)\n            .with_config_overrides(&amp;self.config);\n        let client = ModelClient::new(\n            self.config.clone(),\n            self.auth_manager.clone(),\n            model_family,\n            self.otel_manager.clone(),\n            self.provider.clone(),\n            Some(ReasoningEffort::Medium),\n            ReasoningSummary::Detailed,\n            self.conversation_id,\n            codex_protocol::protocol::SessionSource::Cli, // zapabob: デフォルトはCLI\n        );\n\n        // 4. pub fn create_apply_patch_sse_response(
    patch_content: &str,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // Use shell command to call apply_patch with heredoc format
    let shell_command = format!("apply_patch <<'EOF'\n{patch_content}\nEOF");
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": ["bash", "-lc", shell_command]
    }))?;

    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "shell",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

/// Alias for create_shell_sse_response for backward compatibility
pub fn create_shell_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    create_shell_sse_response(command, workdir, timeout_ms, call_id)
}

/// Create SSE response for exec_command tool (unified_exec)
pub fn create_exec_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // The `arguments` for the `exec_command` tool is similar to shell but uses unified_exec
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": command,
        "workdir": workdir.map(|w| w.to_string_lossy()),
        "timeout": timeout_ms
    }))?;
    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "exec_command",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

        "contents": "&lt;!-- 955c7e55-e604-4504-8f1e-1e871402392f 85f2d8b8-f3ee-4840-bcee-e8c7680c078b --&gt;\n# TUI最新機能マージ計画\n\n## 概要\n\nupstream/mainからTUI関連の最新変更を取り込み、独自機能を保持しながらマージし、ビルドと起動テストまで実施します。\n\n## ステップ\n\n### Phase 1: 下準備と差分確認\n\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; で最新mainを取得\n- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git diff upstream/main -- codex-rs/tui&#96; などで現状差分と独自変更を把握\n\n### Phase 2: マージ (ours優先ベース)\n\n- &#96;git merge upstream/main -X ours&#96; で全体を ours 優先でマージ\n- コンフリクトが発生したTUI関連ファイル（例: &#96;codex-rs/tui/src/**&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; のTUI起動ロジックなど）を個別に精査\n- 上流の新機能コードを取り込みつつ、独自機能や設定は維持（必要に応じて手動マージ）\n\n### Phase 3: ビルドと依存関係更新\n\n- &#96;just tui-build&#96; または &#96;cargo build --release -p codex-tui&#96;\n- 依存関係更新が必要な場合は &#96;cargo update -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; で対応\n\n### Phase 4: 起動確認\n\n- &#96;codex tui&#96; でTUIを起動し、主要機能（画面表示、エージェント操作など）が動作するか手動確認\n\n### Phase 5: 実装ログ作成\n\n- &#96;_docs/&#96; に &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_TUI最新マージ完了.md&#96; を作成し、マージ内容・ビルド結果・起動確認結果・残課題を記録\n\n### To-dos\n\n- [ ] Phase 1.3: GUI-CLI通信拡張 - RPCメソッド追加 (resource.getStatus, resource.acquire, resource.release, cli.codex.execute, cli.gemini.execute, cli.claude.execute)\n- [ ] Phase 7.1: GeminiCLI MCP化拡張 - MCPサーバー起動とCodex統合改善\n- [ ] Phase 7.2: DeepResearch統合 - GeminiCLI経由のDeepResearch実行とGUI表示\n- [ ] Phase 8.1: /plan機能拡張 - Cursor風UI実装とPlanCreator.tsx作成\n- [ ] Phase 6.1: デスクトップ常駐機能拡張\n- [ ] Phase 6.2: 通知機能実装\n- [ ] Phase 4.3: アプリケーション作成インターフェース - AppCreator.tsx作成\n- [ ] Phase 4.4: インターネット接続機能実装",

        "contents": "---\nname: 公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持\noverview: 公式リポジトリ（upstream/main）の最新変更（新機能・脆弱性修正・バグ修正）を完全マージし、公式を優先しつつ独自機能（サブエージェント、Deep Research、オーケストレーション）を公式のAPIに合わせて再実装する\ntodos:\n  - id: fetch-upstream\n    content: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得（git fetch upstream）\n    status: completed\n  - id: merge-upstream\n    content: upstream/mainをマージ（競合解決は公式優先）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - fetch-upstream\n  - id: update-dependencies\n    content: 依存関係を最新版に更新（clap, landlock, openssl-sys, test-log, tracing-opentelemetry）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: fix-tui2-bugs\n    content: TUI2のバグ修正を取り込む（マウス選択境界、スクロール入力）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: fix-panic-bugs\n    content: アルファ版でのパニック修正を取り込む\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: adapt-orchestration\n    content: orchestrationモジュールを公式APIに準拠させる（独自機能は維持）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: adapt-subagents\n    content: sub-agent systemを公式APIに準拠させる（独自機能は維持）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: mark-custom-features\n    content: plan機能など削除された機能を非公式機能として明確化\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: build-verify\n    content: ビルドを実行してエラー・警告を確認・修正\n    status: in_progress\n    dependencies:\n      - update-dependencies",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\plans\\公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持_4b92bb7a.plan.md",

            "line": 46
          }
        },
        "contents": "---\nname: 公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持\noverview: 公式リポジトリ（upstream/main）の最新変更（新機能・脆弱性修正・バグ修正）を取り込み、公式を優先しつつ独自機能（orchestration、agents、deep-research）を公式APIに準拠させて維持する。また、ビルド成果物などの雑多なファイルを.gitignoreに追加してコミット対象から除外する。\ntodos:\n  - id: update-gitignore\n    content: .gitignoreにtarget/を追加してビルド成果物を除外\n    status: completed\n  - id: unstage-build-artifacts\n    content: 既にステージングされているtarget/配下のファイルをアンステージ\n    status: completed\n  - id: fix-remaining-build-errors\n    content: 残っているビルドエラーを修正（型不一致、未解決インポートなど）\n    status: in_progress\n  - id: verify-orchestration-api\n    content: orchestrationモジュールが公式APIに準拠しているか確認・修正\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-agents-api\n    content: agentsモジュールが公式APIに準拠しているか確認・修正\n    status: pending\n  - id: run-tests\n    content: cargo test --all-featuresでテストを実行し、失敗を修正\n    status: pending\n  - id: run-clippy\n    content: cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warningsで警告を確認・修正\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# 公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持プラン\n\n## 現状分析\n\n### 現在の状態\n\n- **ブランチ**: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;\n- **マージ状況**: upstream/mainは既にマージ済み（HEAD..upstream/mainが空）\n- **問題点**: \n- &#96;target/fast/&#96; 配下のビルド成果物が大量にステージングされている\n- &#96;.gitignore&#96; に &#96;target/&#96; が含まれていない\n- ビルドエラーが残っている（前回のセッションから継続）\n\n### 公式の最新変更（既にマージ済み）\n\n1. **機能削除**\n\n- &#96;undo&#96;機能の削除 (#8424)\n- &#96;plan&#96;機能をsystem skillsから削除 (#8374)",
